english.title: Extend well, borehole or other work to abstract water when abstraction prohibited without licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the abstraction of water contained in an underground strata having been prohibited except than in pursuance of a licence under Chapter II of Part II of the Water Resources Act 1991,

(A)_[began]_
(B)_[caused another, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_
(C)_[permitted another, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_

to extend a

(D)_[well]_
(E)_[borehole]_
(F)_[work, namely **(..SPECIFY WORK..),]_

by which water may be abstracted from those strata when the conditions specified in section 24(3) of that Act had not been satisfied in that **(..SPECIFY CONDITION OR CONDITIONS AND HOW IT OR THEY HAD NOT BEEN SATISFIED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 24(2)(b), (4)(a) and (5) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
the abstraction of water contained in an underground strata
having been prohibited other than in pursuance of a licence
by virtue of Chapter II of Part II of the Water Resources Act 1991,
began to extend a well, borehole or other work by which water may have been abstracted from those strata
when the conditions specified in section 24(3) of that Act were not satisfied
